value.rationale: The open complement of the 27 exceptional curves is a canonical arithmetic locus on a smooth cubic surface, and its full zeta is a meaningful exact invariant not determined by the surface Picard Frobenius alone. The signed Eckardt correction isolates a structural obstruction to determining line-free rational points from W(E6) data, and the 25-case exact baseline plus two explicit equal-Picard/different-open examples gives reusable classification data beyond a small numerical improvement.
